summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 84 yen from 78 yen (42 yen interim, 42 yen year-end), reflecting upward revision of FY2027 earnings forecast. Consolidated payout ratio 40.1%.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Hike) and Interim Cash Dividend
translation_en_brief:
Yurtec Corporation has raised its annual dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to 84 yen per share, from the previously announced 78 yen. This comprises an interim dividend of 42 yen per share (based on September 30, 2026) and a year-end dividend of 42 yen per share. The interim dividend of 42 yen totaled 2,885 million yen.

The dividend hike follows a significant upward revision of the company's earnings forecast. Consolidated revenue is now projected at 284 billion yen (up 11 billion yen), with operating profit at 22.1 billion yen (up 3.2 billion yen) and net income attributable to parent company shareholders at 14.3 billion yen (up 1.1 billion yen). The company expects to achieve the medium-term management plan targets for revenue and operating profit ahead of schedule, supported by abundant construction backlog, improved cost management, and expected growth in overseas subsidiary sales.

The company's basic dividend policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of 40% or higher on a stable basis. The revised full-year payout ratio stands at 40.1%, with the interim dividend raised from the previously forecast 39 yen per share.
